summary: Validated 3 bug fixes + full regression for SPILIVERE (MLM binary matrix). Backend: 17/17 pytest assertions PASS in /app/backend/tests/test_bugfix_validation.py. Frontend: smoke tested via Playwright — wallet dynamic UI mobile<->crypto switch works (testIDs wallet-method-mobile, wallet-method-crypto, wallet-address, wallet-phone present and toggle correctly), admin Activations tab displays Hash TXID with admin-copy-tx-* (3 pending crypto activations visible with full hex hash), admin tabs Utilisateurs/Activations/Retraits/Réglages all accessible. Auto-upgrade while loop (`for _ in range(12)`) confirmed present in /app/backend/matrix.py and end-to-end test verified activate_level cascading works (user L0->L1->L2 via admin actions with balance_upgrade credit).

minor.issue: Pydantic EmailStr in /auth/register rejects .local domain — only affects tests, not real users (TLD validation). Test fixture switched to @example.com.

issues: Header gradient lines are visible above the title — non-blocking, purely cosmetic
Spec mentions 'Paramètres' tab; UI uses 'Réglages' label instead. Synonyme acceptable but confirm with user that this is intentional naming.

action_items: (Optional) Align admin tab label 'Réglages' <-> 'Paramètres' if user expects strictly 'Paramètres'.

(Optional) Cascade auto-upgrade past L1 in practice requires matrix descendants — test only verified single-step upgrade; full multi-level cascade in production requires real downstream activations to fill invites_required at each level (this is expected per business spec, not a bug).
critical_code_review_comments: matrix.py distribute_commission — `for _ in range(12)` loop calling try_auto_upgrade is correctly placed AFTER the user gets credited; the loop breaks when no upgrade happens, capped at 12 to prevent infinite loops. Correct fix.
matrix.py try_auto_upgrade — Auto-upgrade is gated by descendants >= invites_required at current level (correct business rule). Without enough downline, cascade simply stops — no bug.

server.py /api/wallet POST — Validates method in {mobile,crypto}; clears OTHER method's fields on save (operator/phone wiped on crypto, wallet_address/network wiped on mobile). Crypto wallet validation requires >= 12 chars — reasonable but consider stricter regex for 0x-prefixed 42-char BEP20 addresses.

server.py /api/withdrawals — Correctly reads method from wallet (with fallback to wallet_address presence) and propagates method/network/wallet_address into withdrawals collection. Admin sees crypto info correctly.
server.py /api/activations/crypto-request — tx_hash min length 8 enforced, stored in activations doc; admin list returns it. UI displays via admin-copy-tx-{id} testID with click-to-copy. Correct.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — wallet switch + admin TXID display + admin tabs all functional
